title: Bookmarks panel and document properties dialog
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; O-03 bookmarks navigate, add, rename, delete and reorder and persist; the document-properties dialog shows real metadata
notes:
Split out of T-0222 round A. T-0255A (committed b26a24d) now provides the real-PDF bridge: pdfxi_edit::navigation::read_outline(&Document) -> OutlineRead and write_outline(&mut Document, &Outline) -> Result<(), OutlineWriteError> (typed errors, 13 tests, PDFium file check).

App plan:
- Panel: a Bookmarks section in the Pages side panel listing the active document's outline tree with depth. Clicking a row with a destination navigates to that zero-based page and applies its fit; a row without a destination is shown but cannot navigate, with the reason from OutlineRead::issues.
- Add: insert at the selected/root position with the current page and a Fit destination, then persist. Rename, delete, move up/down: use insert_bookmark/rename_bookmark/remove_bookmark/move_bookmark on a cloned Outline, write_outline into a cloned Document, and commit via session.edit(|document| { *document = candidate; Ok(()) }) exactly like the comments flow (SessionError has no Annotation variant).
- Repaint/refresh the panel after every commit; the tab is dirty and save/reopen must persist the outline.
- Properties dialog: real /Info and XMP values only; "not set" for absent; never invent.
- Tests on fixtures/realworld/powerpoint-slides.pdf: add a bookmark, rename it, move it, save, reopen, assert order/title/page; delete and assert gone. Add a no-outline fixture (Excel) that gains one.
- Promote VIEW-008 (bookmarks/destinations) and MANAGE-001 (document properties) only after the UI and real-document tests pass; fragment in orchestration/feature-updates/T-0255.toml.
